items.name: Kailua Liʻi Pōʻakahi 2024
items.information:
### Speedcubing returns to O'ahu with a special 3-day series WCA competition! Choose between Kailua Li'i [Pōʻakahi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoakahi2024), [Pōʻalua](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoalua2024), or [Pōʻakolu](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KailuaLiiPoakolu2024) for three different set of events to compete in!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor, it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 4:30 PM.

#### You may only be allowed to compete in one of the three competitions in the Kailua Li'i Series. If you register for more than one competition, only your most recent registration will be accepted.
![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png)
![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png/v1/fit/w_2500,h_1330,al_c/b5378e_88f526a00b5e4d6391ec03e6ea67452c~mv2.png)

items.name: Minnesota Meetup IV Monday 2024
items.information:
This competition will be held on **Monday, August 12th** starting at 5:00 pm and will go throughout the evening. First-timers are encouraged to register!


This competition is a series competition with Minnesota Meetup IV Tuesday 2024. Please see the Series Competitions tab for more information. 

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). 
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7024609ec7ecb5ec9234366d6f29fd0d65974b85/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)
